contentText: Donald Trump has filed his mandatory annual financial disclosure. The report shows the US President made more than 1.4 billion dollars via cryptocurrency ventures last year. That figure represents the overwhelming majority of Trump's personal earnings - a massive sum that has been made possible in large part through the President's own pro-crypto policies. Raising widespread accusations that he is using his office to enrich himself and his family.
